recipe.positive: Visual style (follow exactly): Screen-print poster in the Mondo tradition: flat ink colour blocks with no outlines, limited to two to five spot colours, visible halftone dot gradients instead of smooth gradients, slight mis-registration between colour layers, paper grain and ink texture, bold figure-ground negative space, one iconic symbolic subject with a strong silhouette; any lettering is treated as part of the graphic design, never as an overlay.
